proposals.before: Taizu was called Hongyi Palace, Empress Yingtian was called Changning Palace, Taizong was called Yongxing Palace, Shizong was called Jiqing Palace.
proposals.after: Taizu: Hongyi Palace; Empress Yingtian: Changning Palace; Taizong: Yongxing Palace; Shizong: Jiqing Palace.
proposals.reason: Literal English wrongly treats palace designations as names of the rulers rather than naming each ruler’s palace.

proposals.before: Called called Ouliben, called Yansi, called Miansi, called Yiseng, called North Deli, and called South Deli.
proposals.after: Called Ouliben, called Yansi, called Miansi, called Yiseng, called North Deli, and called South Deli.
proposals.reason: Duplicated “Called called” is a clear corruption of the literal rendering.

proposals.before: Called called Pusuwan, called Yinian, called Woduwang, called Teman, called Moluwan, called Yidian, called Yue, and called Bodeben.
proposals.after: Called Pusuwan, called Yinian, called Woduwang, called Teman, called Moluwan, called Yidian, called Yue, and called Bodeben.
proposals.reason: Duplicated “Called called” is a clear corruption of the literal rendering.

proposals.before: Registered-household gentlemen: At first, when Yaolian Hendejin Khan had the three clans of Puguzhi and others kill Yuyue Shilu, their families were confiscated and entered the wali.
proposals.after: Registered-household gentlemen: At first, when the three clans of Puguzhi and others killed Yuyue Shilu under Yaolian Hendejin Khan, their families were confiscated and entered the wali.
proposals.reason: Chinese 以蒲古只等三族害於越釋魯 marks the three clans as the killers; English “had … kill” overstates the khan’s causative agency.

decisions.reason: 太祖曰弘義宮 pairs each ruler with a palace orudo name; “was called Hongyi Palace” wrongly treats the palace designation as the ruler’s own name. The colon list matches the same 曰 palace-naming pattern continued in s0025.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太祖曰弘義宮，應天皇后曰長寧宮，太宗曰永興宮，世宗曰積慶宮

decisions.reason: Chinese begins 曰歐裏本 with a single 曰; the doubled “Called called” is an English corruption with no source warrant.
Chinese begins 曰蒲速碗 with a single 曰; the doubled “Called called” is an English corruption with no source warrant.

以蒲古只等三族害於越釋魯 names the three clans as those who harmed Yuyue Shilu; the following 籍沒家屬入瓦裏 is punishment of those killers’ households. “Had … kill” invents khan-ordered causative agency the Chinese does not state.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以蒲古只等三族害於越釋魯，籍沒家屬入瓦裏
